defect.source: desktop/src/LibraryView.tsx at fee7d17: books come from the query-filtered list_books; empty-library note requires !query, no-results line requires books.length > 0. Also present in PR #24 (1035101).
defect.reproduction: search-states.e2e.mjs R2 against the fee7d17 build (app sha256 e8e5f7653fc1b7182613c32758f9b50d1f227c61f2792f02415df278af9b9d64)
defect.observed_before: exit 1 at R2; view {cards: [], count: '0 items', noMatch: null, emptyLibrary: null, failure: null} (blank grid); failure.png

repair: LibraryView records the query its listing answers (listedQuery) and the failure of the latest listing (listError). Settled + query + 0 books: 'No books match “q”.' with Clear search. Settled + no query + 0 books: existing empty-library note. Settled + books + 0 visible: existing 'Nothing here…' line. Failed listing for the current query: role=alert 'Searching for “q” failed: <reason>' (or 'Your library could not be listed') and no cards. Nothing is decided while a request is in flight. Whitespace-only queries count as no query, as the backend treats them.

check_notes: Final checks ran sequentially from one script on HEAD c2e157f with a clean tree before and after (evidence held outside the repo).

Development detour, not a product finding: the journey's state probe first returned an object with an `error` key, which webdriverio interprets as a WebDriver error response; polls failed silently and R8 timed out although the alert was shown. Renamed to `failure` (commented in the journey). A role=status experiment build was made and reverted; the final binary hash equals the first repaired build.
Web jobs were not rerun locally (no web change); CI runs them.

Loading state is checked by DOM observation, not by an artificially slowed backend.
known_risks: The failure alert reuses the existing .status style (not a distinct error colour).
Other callers of the listing (Rescan, Save URL, undo, merge) still also show their own status line on failure, so a failed listing there can show two messages.
local_verification_required: Windows installed app on a disposable library: search a word with no match -> message and Clear search; clear -> library back.
review_walkthrough: Search a word that matches nothing: 'No books match “word”.' with Clear search; press it: library back.
Pick a shelf with no members: 'Nothing here.' (unchanged).
